title: feat(studio): author context packs (ai_context) in Studio — a form, and a related-lists block scoped to each child
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH8HwrkPJDQVtqCcoED6n6og)_

Fixes #37143

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new public export, `aiContextForm` from `@objectstack/spec/ai`, and `/meta/types` now serves a form for `ai_context`; no key is added to what a pack may hold
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用作者在 Studio 里可以新建、编辑资料包：选根对象和它的字段，选指向它的关联列表并为每个列表选列，选正文字段，再保存发布。
- 为什么做：记录 AI 问询专题的第 7 步，让资料包不必写在代码包里（运行时可编辑）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是编辑界面选项不对或保存被拒；已有的资料包和对象的关联列表编辑不受影响，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

ADR-0160 D1, clause 2 (runtime authoring). The type was already registered with `allowRuntimeCreate: true` and its author defects are already reported at save (`validateAiContext` on the runtime publish door); what was missing was a form, so Studio's generic metadata editor had nothing to lay a pack out with.

- **`aiContextForm`** (`packages/spec/src/ai/ai-context.form.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/spec/ai`, registered as `ai_context` in `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`), by the `skill.form.ts` precedent. Two sections: Basics (`name`, `label`, the root `object` through `ref:object`) and Material (`fields` as `field-multi` with `dependsOn: 'object'`, the `page.form.ts` precedent; `related` as `related-list-entries` with `dependsOn: 'object'`, the `object.form.ts` precedent; `body` as a composite whose `field` is a `field-ref` over the root). The form names every top-level key `AiContextSchema` accepts and no other (the registry-wide reconciliation test).
- **The `related-list-entries` block learns the pack's entry shape** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ContextPackRelatedEntries.tsx`). A pack entry is `{ object, field?, fields? }`, not the object form's bare name or `{ list, label?, columns? }`, so the block now tells the two apart by the entry schema it is handed (`items.properties.object`), never by the type's name:
  - the add picker offers every reference field of a served object whose target is the root, resolved with the spec's own `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` and `referenceTargetOf`, the link `validateAiContext` resolves (a self-reference and each of a child's several links included); a pick is written `{ object, field }`;
  - each entry's columns are picked from THAT child object's fields (`useObjectFields`, draft-overlaid), never the root's;
  - it stops at the schema's `maxItems` (3 lists, 10 columns), and an emptied list or column set removes its key (both arrays are `minItems: 1`);
  - a stored entry the catalog shows no link for is kept and marked; the save-time report is its judge.
  - The object form's `relatedLists` keeps its chip face, unchanged (`RelatedListNameEntries`, the old body).
  - while the object list is loading, or after it failed (`getTypeStatus('object')`), no stored entry is marked unlinked and the add picker says loading / could not load, never "no reference field".
- **An emptied picker removes its key** (L2 review on this PR, S1). Removing the last chip of a `field-multi` whose schema has `minItems >= 1` (the pack's `fields`) removes the key instead of writing `[]`; in a composite, a cleared sub-field drops its key (as `setField` already does at the top level), and a composite left empty while its schema requires a key that has no default is removed (the pack's `body` after "None") instead of written as `{ field: '' }`. A composite whose required keys all carry a default keeps `{}` (S3: `/meta/types` serves the output derivation, which lists a defaulted key as required; a view's `pagination: {}` and `selection: {}` are read by their presence). Both were drafts the save door refuses with no way back in the form. `SchemaForm.tsx` (`compositeWith`) and `widgets.tsx` (`emptyArrayRefused`).
- **Words**: eleven `engine.form.contextPack.*` keys in the studio namespace (en, zh); the platform's `metadataForms.ai_context` bundles regenerated (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`), with the zh-CN leaves translated by hand, and the console's zh-CN overlay rows (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`) copied from them.
- `api-surface/ai.json` and `export-origins/ai.json` regenerated for the one new export.

#37180's outcome, read for the soft dependency: PR #37209 (merged by the maintainer) puts `ai_context` in ADR-0150's package-scoped bucket beside `skill`. A pack created in Studio is therefore saved the way a skill created in Studio is, into the package the editor is working in; nothing in this PR picks a package for it, and the reader move is #37216.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ai/ai-context.form.test.ts`: the registry entry, the identity rows, and every picker scoped by `object`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ContextPackRelatedEntries-37143.test.tsx` (12): the four rework pins (loading / idle / error catalog marks nothing; the pack's last root field removed writes no key; an array without `minItems` still writes `[]`; "None" for the body removes `body`, a composite requiring nothing keeps `{}`), and the original eight: the schema discriminator; the links offered (four, the self-reference and both links of one child, an unrelated object absent); a pick written as `{ object, field }`; columns offered from the child, not the root; column and list removal dropping their keys; an unlinked stored entry kept and marked and a listed link not offered again; the bound and the no-root state; the host id on the add picker. Every value the block writes is parsed with `AiContextSchema`.
- `RelatedListEntriesWidget-35923.test.tsx` (the object form's face) still passes unchanged.
- `openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts` (app-shell console): one row, `ContextPackRelatedEntries.tsx` classified `off` among the readers of `useMetadata().objects` (the block reads the served object list for its link catalog and is mounted only in the metadata admin, never on an app's object-list open).
- `bare-type-display-echo-decisions.test.ts` and `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (platform-objects): literal counts and a dated comment row only, because `ai_context` now has a form and its eighteen leaves are authored in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES (surface widened by the seat, claim amendment 1).

Ablation, one at a time with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob equal to HEAD after each restore): the `field-multi` prune off, the composite's empty-required prune deleted, the catalog state forced `ready`; each turns exactly its own pin red (1 failed of 12).

Ablation: the default check removed (every required key counts) turns those three red (3 failed of 16), restored to HEAD. Swept every composite row of the registered forms against the served derivation: the rows whose required keys all carry defaults (view `selection`, `pagination`, `gallery`, `userFilters`, `appearance`, `userActions`, `navigation`, `sharing`; object `enable`, `access`, `publicSharing`; field `currencyConfig`; hook `retryPolicy`; report and dashboard `dateRange`, dashboard `header`; page `interfaceConfig.appearance`, `interfaceConfig.userActions`; agent `planning`; flow `errorHandling`) keep `{}`; the rest have a required key with no default and are removed when emptied.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` type-check (the ui workspace's own packages have no `dist/` in this container, so tsc stops on module resolution); `Type Check UI` is the reading.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's end-to-end clause (an author creates a pack in Studio and `get_record_context` serves it) is covered here in pieces, not by one booted host: the block's every write parses as a pack; the metadata API save of an `ai_context` row is `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` (metadata-protocol); the record-context door reads the protocol's merged `ai_context` listing (`mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts`, runtime). Measured once live as well (showcase booted with `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, the `ui/` console served by Vite against it, Chromium via Playwright, at the rework's source): Studio → AI → AI Context Pack → create `project_brief` on `showcase_project` saved and published (`PUT …/meta/ai_context/project_brief?mode=draft` 200, `POST …/publish` 200); edit: root fields `name`, `status`; the add picker offered the four links to the root (`showcase_client_brief.project`, `showcase_field_zoo.f_master_detail`, `showcase_project_membership.project`, `showcase_task.project`); the columns offered were `showcase_task`'s fields; body chosen then set to "None"; saved body `{"name":"project_brief","label":"Project brief","object":"showcase_project","fields":["name","status"],"related":[{"object":"showcase_task","field":"project","fields":["title","status"]}]}` (no `body` key), 200 and published. A second edit removed both root fields: saved without `fields`, 200. Then MCP `get_record_context` (`objectName: showcase_project`, `context: project_brief`) on a seeded project answered the pack, with the task rows' `title` and `status`.
- The body picker offers every root field, not only the long-text ones: `field-ref` has no type filter, and a non-long-text pick is reported at save (`ai-context-body-not-long-text`).
- The link catalog is the console's served object list (`useMetadata().objects`); an object it does not serve is not offered, and a stored entry naming one is kept and marked.

## Verification

Two minutes: open Studio, pick a package, open AI → AI Context Pack (advanced fold), create one; choose a root object with a child list (showcase: an object another object looks up), add the related list and pick a column. Expected: the column picker lists the child object's fields, and the Source tab shows `related: [{ object, field, fields }]`.

Read first, by risk: `ContextPackRelatedEntries.tsx` (`contextPackLinks`, `ContextPackRelatedEntries`), the dispatch at the top of `RelatedListEntriesWidget` in `widgets.tsx`, `ai-context.form.ts`.
